"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out.
